derivation: from H5526 (סָכַךְ) in the sense of H7753 (שׂוּךְ);

occurrences.text: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
